evals.prompt: Write a spec for a new bundle landing page
assertions: Copies the spec template and names one primary action
Lists sections in order with copy source and media from the manifest
Defines acceptance with widths, keyboard path, reduced motion and the covering Playwright spec

evals.prompt: Spec the guarantee block with a 30 day promise
assertions: Flags the guarantee period as an owner decision instead of inventing it
Takes facts only from config or content

evals.prompt: Spec a page and also write its code
assertions: Produces a spec only, with no implementation code
states what was verified and what was not
